kids.chars: 300 BTC: example, never a recommendation (MEMO OQ-3)

node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT (seed 574) 1m series of 800 bars to the forming bar 14:05 UTC; tick and qty step from the recorded instrument fixture; volumes, deltas, trades, prices, the thresholds' example bounds and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic. No account data, key or balance. C-2.11 (R-1): the strip reads the live public trade stream on demo and live alike; no DEMO / LIVE badge and no environment control appears; nothing on this board differs by environment.

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Theme: dark (exported as docs/design/E20/img/E20-D02-07-scr033-catalogue-reorder.png); §0 L60: 10 boards, 0 light twins — the light and high-contrast renders are not drawn, the text is binding; every fill here is a neutral token, so the T2 and breach grammar holds under any theme switch

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Greyscale, desktop, 1280 × 800 windows (§0): a wireframe — colour, type, iconography and elevation are E20-D03's

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: CMP-043 Dialog, size md, title "Deep Stats rows"; a CMP-056 list of the 20 rows in the user's order, enabled rows first, the rest in 24 §7 order; the body scrolls (§6.1)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Per row: the drag handle (pointer only, not a stop), the enable checkbox with the §7 label, Format (W-21, PROPOSED, D02-G3), Sparkline (PROPOSED, D02-A4), Threshold (aria-expanded; absent on flag and price rows: "No threshold"), ⋯; every target ≥ 24 × 24 (2.5.8)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: SCR-033's Big-trade count and Imbalance count are not drawn (no §7 descriptor; MEMO G2, D02-C5); CMP-031 is not drawn (colour is E20-D03's)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Not drawn (§0 lists no open-menu frame): the Format menu's W-21 items, "Decimals" and "Abbreviate (1.2k)" (§6.2, PROPOSED, D02-G3); the text is binding

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: On open, focus lands on the first enabled row's checkbox (drawn); the list is one Tab stop with a roving row

kids.name: value-7
kids.chars: Apply closes the dialog, applies everything, announces W-22 once and returns focus to the gear; chart.deepstats_rows_changed with {rows} fires on Apply only, never per toggle (14:875; §6.6)

kids.name: value-8
kids.chars: Cancel and Esc discard every change

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ on the focused row (its checkbox) move it one position (E47-D09:173, DE-13; 14:871): Cumulative Delta after one Alt+↑ from position 5

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: The focused row shows the hint chip right of its label; the keys are ignored on Format, Threshold, ⋯ and the threshold select and field (the row menu is the path there)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: The moved row keeps focus: the ring (E47-D04:229) moves with the row, never on the handle alone; the row is scrolled clear of the sticky toolbar and footer (2.4.11)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: {total} counts the enabled rows (E20.json:394's example); the list reorders at once, the strip changes on Apply (D02-F2)

value-1.chars: §2 L135: row menu, open on the first row (Move up T2 2a; CMP-079, CMP-019 lock) — specified in §6.3; §1.4 (board 07)

value-2.chars: The second path: the row menu's Move up / Move down on ⋯ (E47-D09:140); CMP-056's per-row "Move {row} up / down" buttons are not drawn (D02-F1; MEMO A9)

value-3.chars: The menu opens on the row whose ⋯ was pressed, drawn on the first row (Delta). At the range ends Move up or Move down is T2 rendering 2a (E09-D09:49): CMP-019 lock leads its label and CMP-056's "Already first." (first row, drawn) or "Already last." (last row) is its second line (§1.4; D02-F3); Enter or Space changes nothing and re-shows the reason with one polite announcement

value-4.chars: After a row-menu move focus returns to the row's menu button

value-2.chars: Under a row whose Threshold toggle is expanded: a comparison select (>, <, >=, <=, abs >; E20.json:420), abs > by default on signed rows (MEMO AD-6), and a bound field

value-3.chars: Delta % (a percent row): 0–100 % (14:870), the story's 60 %; Delta (a unit row): an absolute field in BTC, its bounds E20-S03's (D02-A3); flag and price rows show "No threshold"

value-4.chars: The set selector above the list (PROPOSED): "Set: Global" or "Set: ETHUSDT (this symbol)", naming what the legend will say (W-1, W-2); a symbol with no set falls back to the default (E20.json:420)

value-5.chars: The entry opens only on the toggle, never on focus: tabbing never shifts the rows below (§6.2)
